fusions.name: Forged Notes
fusions.desc: Looses 3 forged notes at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage and has a 15% chance to turn its target against its own allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Called-In Debt
fusions.desc: Serves the target a forged notice of debt that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Cooked Books
fusions.desc: Each critical hit skims 6 mana back to you. Once every 5 seconds.
